milestones.title: Contribute to Jeram Padang asnaf aid and mosque support
milestones.description: Shamshulkahar represented KPTM in assistance for 96 asnaf recipients and contributed RM30,000 to Masjid Felda Palong 2 plus RM6,000 for iftar.
milestones.progress_note: This party-published handover report covers the stated contributions. The separate 230-person elderly assistance and 30 food-box distribution are not attributed solely to him.
